H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5273: delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H7495: properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H2280: to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule
H6094: a idol; also, a pain or wound
H4487: properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll
H4557: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
H3556: a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince

H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character

H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H8394: intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H5749: to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication)
H6035: depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly)
H8213: to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce

H3680: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H5645: properly, an envelope, i.e. darkness (or density, 2 Chronicles 4:17); specifically, a (scud) cloud; also a copse
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)

H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)

H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1369: force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory

H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H7521: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3176: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H7623: properly, to address in aloud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words)

H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H2459: fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part
H2406: wheat, whether the grain or the plant
H7646: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H7323: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3713: properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground)
H6340: to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H7140: ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H5380: to blow; by implication, to disperse
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H5140: to drip, or shed by trickling
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H2706: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)

H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
